metadata.description: Community-driven marketplace for Claude Code plugins featuring git automation and commit management

plugins.name: 1pass
plugins.description: Install and manage 1Password CLI (op) and op-exec in Claude Code sessions. Provides session-start auto-install for web sessions and comprehensive workflow skills.

plugins.name: agent-tab-titles
plugins.description: Set tmux/iTerm2 tab titles to agent roles in agent team sessions. Disables Claude Code's LLM-generated titles and uses SessionStart hook to set role-based names.

plugins.name: agentic-behavior
plugins.description: Skills for configuring Claude Code, behavior correction, memory tracking, autonomy rules, and time-context awareness. Combines prompt history tracking, git-backed memory sync, and the self-checking Ralph loop pattern.

plugins.name: arcane
plugins.description: Skills for deploying docker-compose stacks via Arcane GitOps — directory conventions, secrets management with 1Password, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Skills for managing Cloudflare developer platform components including Workers, R2, D1, AI Gateway, Pages, Tunnels, and more — with Pulumi IaC setup for each.

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Simplify and refine code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability. Requires pr-review-toolkit plugin.

plugins.name: command-help-skill
plugins.description: Help claude understand, discover, and execute slash commands when accidentally sent as a message.

plugins.name: common-sense
plugins.description: Common-sense rules for AI assistant behavior. On session start, symlinks bundled rules into the project's .claude/rules/common-sense directory so they are automatically loaded as context.

plugins.name: context-bloat-prevention
plugins.description: Prevents context window bloat from large tool outputs. PostToolUse hook detects oversized results and instructs Claude to save to file instead of keeping in context. PreToolUse hook redirects Bash commands that are likely to produce large output.

plugins.name: correct-behavior
plugins.description: Command to correct AI behavior mistakes and update rules to prevent recurrence

plugins.name: create-command
plugins.description: Create and maintain Claude Code slash commands with guided assistance

plugins.name: daily-report
plugins.description: Skill for generating daily organization-wide reports covering commits, PRs, branches, and issue changes across all repositories in a GitHub org. Designed for scheduled CI workflows and on-demand reporting.

plugins.name: data-serialization
plugins.description: Data format conversion and querying utilities. Supports YAML, JSON, TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation), and XML/HTML transformations with special handling for Playwright accessibility snapshots. TOON provides 30-60% token reduction vs JSON for LLM contexts.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Multi-agent deep research system for complex investigations. Uses a lead-researcher orchestrator, parallel sub-researchers, and a critical-reviewer to produce evidence-based reports with confidence levels and citations.

plugins.name: edit-utils
plugins.description: File editing utilities: auto-formatting and linting for written/edited files with project-aware configuration

plugins.name: fix-pr
plugins.description: Relentlessly fix a PR until CI passes — iterates through review, fix, push cycles until green

plugins.name: git-spice
plugins.description: Skill for managing stacked Git branches with git-spice (gs) CLI tool

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub CLI installation, authentication, and workflow skill for Claude Code sessions. Consolidates gh-tool and github-auth-skill into a single plugin.

plugins.name: github-app
plugins.description: Automatic GitHub App token lifecycle for Claude Code sessions. Generates installation tokens on session start, monitors expiry via PreToolUse hook, and refreshes transparently before commands that need authentication.

plugins.name: google-workspace-cli
plugins.description: Install and manage the Google Workspace CLI (gws) with per-service skills for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, Tasks, Contacts, and Admin

plugins.name: incident-tracker
plugins.description: Track behavioral incidents, document corrections, and maintain learned rules with footnote references

plugins.name: linear-mcp-sync
plugins.description: Installs Linear MCP and adds hooks for safe ticket updates with hash validation to prevent stale overwrites

plugins.name: mcp-tooling
plugins.description: Skills for MCP CLI tools, frameworks, proxy daemoning, and gateway patterns. Covers philschmid/mcp-cli, mcp-use, apify/mcpc, mcp-proxy daemoning, and MCP gateway architecture for sharing servers across sessions and networks.

plugins.name: memory-manager
plugins.description: Intelligent memory management for CLAUDE.md files. Automatically detects and stores user preferences, rules, and instructions with smart scope detection and hierarchical organization.

plugins.name: mise
plugins.description: Install and manage mise (tool version manager) in Claude Code sessions. Provides session-start auto-install for web sessions and comprehensive workflow skills.

plugins.name: og-image
plugins.description: Generate OpenGraph images for Nuxt/Vue pages using HTML templates and html2png.dev API

plugins.name: permissions-sync
plugins.description: Merge permission scopes from configurable source settings.json files into settings.local.json on session start. Supports project-level and user-level installation.

plugins.name: plugin-management
plugins.description: Skill for installing, updating, and managing Claude Code plugins — including what requires a restart and what hot-reloads.

plugins.name: proxmox
plugins.description: Skills for managing Proxmox VE hosts and LXC containers — creating containers, running Docker in LXC, and hosting services like cloudflared.

plugins.name: remote-config
plugins.description: Sync upstream Claude config repo on session start. Pulls latest from a configured git repo to ~/.claude-remote/ and reports update status.

plugins.name: review-changes
plugins.description: Review code changes with detailed feedback on quality, security, performance, and maintainability

plugins.name: safety-evaluation-prompt
plugins.description: Pre-tool-call safety evaluation using prompt-style hooks for inline AI evaluation

plugins.name: safety-evaluation-script
plugins.description: Pre-tool-call safety evaluation using Claude CLI (haiku) with script-style hooks

plugins.name: scm-utils
plugins.description: Source control management utilities for improving interactions with branches and PRs, both locally and in CI environments

plugins.name: sdlc-utils
plugins.description: Software development lifecycle utilities — skills organized by SDLC phase: plan, implement, review, test, deploy, and maintain.

plugins.name: self-terminate
plugins.description: Allows Claude to gracefully terminate itself using SIGINT

plugins.name: sequential-thinking
plugins.description: Set up the sequential-thinking MCP server and auto-configure permissions for its tools on session start.

plugins.name: session-report
plugins.description: Skill for generating structured session reports — fact-finding across git history, GitHub issues and PRs, tasks, and agent contributions to produce a comprehensive work summary. Works for solo agents and agent teams alike.

plugins.name: skill-required
plugins.description: Enforces that specified skills are loaded before certain tools can be used. Tracks skill reads via PostToolUse and blocks tool use via PreToolUse if the required skill hasn't been recently loaded.

plugins.name: skills-maintenance
plugins.description: Agent skill for maintaining, updating, and improving existing Claude Code skills

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Configurable status line for Claude Code showing session info, project context, and git status

plugins.name: statusline-iterm
plugins.description: Status line for Claude Code with iTerm2 badge integration - shows session info, project context, git status, and updates iTerm2 badge

plugins.name: task-parallelization
plugins.description: Intelligent skill that helps Claude parallelize Task tool calls when working on repetitive or batch operations, optimizing throughput based on task complexity

plugins.name: tmux-subagent
plugins.description: Launch independent Claude sub-agents in tmux sessions with custom configurations, tool restrictions, and iTerm integration

plugins.name: todo-plus-plus
plugins.description: Enforces commit-on-complete for tasks and reminds about ephemeral session awareness

plugins.name: todo-sync
plugins.description: Automatically syncs todos and plans from ~/.claude/ to the current project's .claude/ directory

plugins.name: web-auto-approve
plugins.description: Auto-approve Edit, Write, and Bash permission requests in Claude Code web sessions to suppress interactive permission prompts

plugins.name: word-vomit
plugins.description: Hook-based workflow for capturing unstructured thoughts and triggering the exec-assist agent to categorize them into actionable items (issues, tasks, docs).

plugins.name: zai-glm
plugins.description: Skills for using z.ai (Zhipu AI) GLM models and configuring Claude Code to access them via the Anthropic-compatible endpoint or API gateways.
